reels.title: When Does Night End and Day Begin? A Riddle with an Unexpected Answer
reels.why: The riddle holds the viewer until the end because the children's first two answers sound correct, while the third brings a twist and a clear point. It is short, humorous, and understandable without context.
reels.speaker: Don Vitomir Zečević
reels.quote: Night ends and day begins when we see the image of God in every human being.

cards.text: When does night truly end?
Don Vitomir Zečević · Salesian, Youth Center
From the spiritual renewal for men at the Sanctuary of Divine Mercy in Ovčara near Đakovo
Night ends and day begins when we see the image of God in every human being.

reels.title: Eye Cancer, Surgery, and Advice: "First Surrender It to Jesus"
reels.hook: Diagnosis: eye cancer. What to do first?
reels.why: This is a concrete story with a real diagnosis, surgery, and doctor, ending with a humorous twist and clear advice. Faith and medicine do not exclude each other here.
reels.speaker: Don Vitomir Zečević
reels.quote: Jesus is the best ophthalmologist. He knows best for you.

cards.text: Diagnosis: eye cancer. What to do first?
Don Vitomir Zečević · Salesian, Youth Center
Don Vitomir recounts what he advised a priest who received a severe diagnosis

Jesus works through that doctor.

reels.title: Do Not Compare Yourself: You Are Not a Copy, You Are an Original

reels.speaker: Don Vitomir Zečević
reels.quote: Yes, but you are not a copy. You are an original.

cards.text: Stop comparing yourself to others
Don Vitomir Zečević · Salesian, Youth Center
From the spiritual renewal for men in Ovčara near Đakovo

reels.title: How to Fight Against Pornography: Learn to Say "No"
reels.hook: Your "yes" is worthless if you do not know how to say "no"
reels.why: A strong thought about freedom opens the section with concrete steps: filters, redirecting thoughts, fasting, Rosary, and sacraments. The topic is directly intended for the channel's audience, and the section does not rely on questionable statistics.
reels.speaker: Don Vitomir Zečević
reels.quote: a person's yes means nothing if the person cannot say no.

reels.hook: A tattoo with Jesus? The priest has a clear answer
reels.why: A direct and provocative stance on a topic about which many have an opinion, so it encourages comments. It is short and rounded off with the assertion that the body is a temple of the Holy Spirit.
